about.section_title: A first-year student who already ships full-stack systems

cards.title: Who I am
cards.text: I'm a first-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at NIAT, S-VYASA University in Bengaluru. I work in Python, SQL, FastAPI and JavaScript, and I learn by building complete projects: a REST backend with a MySQL database, an AI computer-vision pipeline, and a deployed multi-page website.

cards.title: What I build
cards.text: Backends and data layers. That means MySQL schemas with stored procedures and spatial de-duplication, JWT-secured FastAPI services, and YOLOv8 / OpenCV pipelines that turn camera footage and geo-tagged photos into structured, queryable data.

cards.title: Education
cards.text: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, NIAT, S-VYASA University. Pre-University in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Computer Science at Sri Kumaran Children's Home PU College. Secondary school at Holy Saint High School.

cards.title: Interests & goals
cards.text: I care about software architecture, cybersecurity, clean code, data structures and algorithms, and problem solving. I'm looking for an SDE internship or junior developer role where I can apply a builder's mindset to real-world software.
